jobs.description: Supply Chain Process Engineer / Project Manager (f/m/d)- Operations Center Neuenburg 2- 80% - 100%- Supply Chain Management- EnglischAs the top Swiss e-commerce platform, with a crew of over 4'000 across Switzerland, Germany, and Serbia, Galaxus is poised to move into new markets. Our driving force is our determination to keep challenging the status quo. That’s why we’re on the lookout for characters who’re passionate about making genuine improvements. We’ll give you the freedom and trust to make an impact, to grow with us and to be yourself. Act galactic. Be you.Your journey begins at our established logistics center in Wohlen, Switzerland (2-3 days per week), where you will get to know our processes, culture, and team while contributing to the cross-site project for the new location from day one. Through targeted training, workshops, and close collaboration with experienced colleagues, you will gain the insights and support needed to successfully transition into your role.This way you experience a fully functioning operation firsthand and actively shape the future in Neuenburg at the same time. During the ramp-up phase, you act as a pragmatic all-rounder: You tackle problems wherever they arise and resolve operational bottlenecks immediately – whether at your desk or on the shop floor.Deine Aufgaben- You will develop, design and optimize logistics processes for our new location in Neuenburg- In Supply Chain Management, you constantly work to improve existing processes, optimally implement new ones, and document them appropriately- You assess new ideas together with relevant stakeholders, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis- You ensure proper training, documentation, and correct application of processes by regularly participating in operational logistics activities- Depending on the situation, you assume different responsibilities during project implementation, including coordinating project teams as a project manager or independently driving optimization initiatives- You identify optimization opportunities, initiate the necessary actions, and ensure their successful implementationDeine Fähigkeiten- A university degree (FH, University, ETH) in Process Management, or a related field, such as Industrial Engineering, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification- At least 3 years of professional experience in process development or project management in an industrial or logistics environment; experience with automated systems is an advantage as well as experience with SQL- Successfully led and implemented projects, ideally combined with experience in Lean Management- Flexibility to work temporarily in Wohlen and later at the new logistics center in Neuenburg, along with approximately 20% travel within Switzerland- Fluent in English and German, French is an advantage- The capacity to adapt to ongoing changes in the work environment- Identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing changes to enhance productivity and effectivenessWarum startest du bei uns?- Values, not empty words: Cooperative, innovative, piratesque, responsible, ambitious – these five values are what we practise and preach- Courageous thinking: We encourage everyone to think on their feet, and love it when they come up with bold or edgy ideas- Uncomplicated approach: Simplicity is at our core. We avoid the unnecessary and focus on what really matters – from overcoming challenges to celebrating our shared successes- Flexibility and freedom: Every position is possible with an 80% workload- Rapid growth: With us, growth is a continuous journey. We also support you with EDU points (https://www.galaxus.de/en/page/more-training-sign-me-up-20943)  (1600 € and 2000 minutes) per year for your professional development so there’s no risk of you getting stuck in a rut- More benefits: 28 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, a shuttle service and other benefitsDiversity is our culture.To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.

For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams. TOFTOF is a neutron time-of-flight chopper spectrometer to study dynamic processes in hard and soft condensed matter. The main areas of application are from materials science, soft matter, biological or magnetic systems. After years of successful operation, the instrument will receive a significant technical upgrade in the coming years.  For the further development and the operation of the instrument TOFTOF we invite applications for a full-time (40 h/week) scientist position (m/f/d) as Instrument Scientist TOFTOF (m/f/d) Tasks and Responsibilities You will be responsible for the scientific oversight of the technical upgrade of the instrument TOFTOF and attend to its technical realisation.  Your tasks include:  Scientific lead of TOFTOF's further developments, i.e. of the neutron transport and chopper system. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications. Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOF Experimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performance Method development in the area of neutron spectroscopy Operation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operation Pursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methods Your responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.  Qualification and Experience PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field. Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. Experience with polarized neutrons are an asset.  Demonstrated ability to conduct instrumentation projects and operate complex scientific setups.  Knowledge of scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB) is required, experience with ray tracing simulation packages, e.g. McStas, are beneficial. Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team. Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profile Persuasive communication skills and ability to work in a team in an international environment are mandatory. Good oral and written English skills are required, German language skills are an asset. For further information about the position, please contact Wiebke Lohstroh, E-Mail: wiebke.lohstroh@frm2.tum.de The high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees. Benefits We offer flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation per year and a company pension plan (VBL). As an employee of FRM II, you can benefit from many other TUM offers, such as  TUM's health offers University sports  TUM's internal continuing education and training opportunities TUM childcare (subject to availability)  Very good accessibility by public transport The position is remunerated according to TV-L and limited to 3 years. The position is suitable for severely disabled people. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if they otherwise have essentially the same suitability, qualifications and professional performance. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women. Applications from women are therefore expressly welcomed. perspective- You will support releases and ensure the reliable operation of CI/CD pipelines, including up-to-date compliance and security checks for our builds and deployments- You will further
